##### Constant / Linear Rational Function {#sec-pmd-8121}

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| message: false
#| label: fig-pmd-8121-examples
#| fig-cap: "Examples of constant/linear rational functions"
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

p1 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(-1.5, 1.5)), aes(x)) +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) 1 / (1 + 2 * x)) +
  labs(title = "y = 1/(1+2x)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

p2 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(32, 35)), aes(x)) +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) 7 / (1 - 0.03 * x)) +
  labs(title = "y = 7/(1-0.03x)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

p1 + p2
```

**Function:** $f(x) = \dfrac{\beta_0}{1 + \beta_1 x}, \ \ \beta_0 \neq 0, \ \beta_1 \neq 0$

**Function Family:** Rational

**Statistical Type:** Nonlinear

**Domain:** $\left(-\infty, \ -\dfrac{1}{\beta_1}\right) \ \cup \ \left(-\dfrac{1}{\beta_1}, \ \infty\right)$

**Range:** $(-\infty, \ 0) \ \cup \ (0, \ \infty)$

**Special Features:** Horizontal asymptote at $y = 0$ and vertical asymptote at $x = -\dfrac{1}{\beta_1}$.

##### Linear / Linear Rational Function {#sec-pmd-8122}

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| label: fig-pmd-8122-examples
#| fig-cap: "Examples of linear/linear rational functions"
p1 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(-1.5, 1.5)), aes(x)) +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) (1 + 2 * x) / (1 + 3 * x)) +
  labs(title = "y = (1+2x)/(1+3x)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

p2 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(-1.5, 1.5)), aes(x)) +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) (-1 + 2 * x) / (1 + 3 * x)) +
  labs(title = "y = (-1+2x)/(1+3x)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

p1 + p2
```

**Function:** $f(x) = \dfrac{\beta_0 + \beta_1 x}{1 + \beta_2 x}, \ \ \beta_1 \neq 0, \ \beta_2 \neq 0$

**Function Family:** Rational

**Statistical Type:** Nonlinear

**Domain:** $\left(-\infty, \ -\dfrac{1}{\beta_2}\right) \ \cup \ \left(-\dfrac{1}{\beta_2}, \ \infty\right)$

**Range:** $\left(-\infty, \ \dfrac{\beta_1}{\beta_2}\right) \ \cup \ \left(\dfrac{\beta_1}{\beta_2}, \ \infty\right)$

**Special Features:** Horizontal asymptote at $y = \dfrac{\beta_1}{\beta_2}$ and vertical asymptote at $x = -\dfrac{1}{\beta_2}$.

##### Linear / Quadratic Rational Function {#sec-pmd-8123}

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| label: fig-pmd-8123-examples
#| fig-cap: "Examples of linear/quadratic rational functions"
p1 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(-10, 10)), aes(x)) +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) (1 + 2 * x) / (1 - (1 / 12) * x - (1 / 12) * x^2)) +
  labs(title = "y = (1+2x)/(1-(1/12)x-(1/12)x^2)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

p2 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(-10, 10)), aes(x)) +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) (1 + 2 * x) / (1 + 2 * x + x^2)) +
  labs(title = "y = (1+2x)/(1+2x+x^2)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

p3 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(-100, 100)), aes(x)) +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) (1 + 2 * x) / (1 + (1 / 15) * x + (1 / 15) * x^2)) +
  labs(title = "y = (1+2x)/(1+(1/15)x+(1/15)x^2)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

(p1 + p2) / p3
```

**Function:** $f(x) = \dfrac{\beta_0 + \beta_1 x}{1 + \beta_2 x + \beta_3 x^2}, \ \ \beta_1 \neq 0, \ \beta_3 \neq 0$

**Function Family:** Rational

**Statistical Type:** Nonlinear

**Domain:** $(-\infty, \infty)$ with undefined points at $x = \dfrac{-\beta_2 \pm \sqrt{\beta_2^2 - 4\beta_3}}{2\beta_3}$. There will be 0, 1, or 2 real solutions to this equation, corresponding to whether $\beta_2^2 - 4\beta_3$ is negative, zero, or positive.

**Range:** $(-\infty, \infty)$

**Special Features:** Horizontal asymptote at $y = 0$ and vertical asymptotes at $x = \dfrac{-\beta_2 \pm \sqrt{\beta_2^2 - 4\beta_3}}{2\beta_3}$. There will be 0, 1, or 2 real solutions to this equation corresponding to whether $\beta_2^2 - 4\beta_3$ is negative, zero, or positive.

##### Quadratic / Linear Rational Function {#sec-pmd-8124}

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| label: fig-pmd-8124-examples
#| fig-cap: "Examples of quadratic/linear rational functions"
p1 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(-1.5, 1.5)), aes(x)) +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) (1 + 2 * x - 3 * x^2) / (1 - 4 * x)) +
  labs(title = "y = (1+2x-3x^2)/(1-4x)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

p2 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(-3, 4)), aes(x)) +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) (1 + 2 * x + 5 * x^2) / (1 + 7 * x)) +
  labs(title = "y = (1+2x+5x^2)/(1+7x)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

p1 + p2
```

**Function:** $f(x) = \dfrac{\beta_0 + \beta_1 x + \beta_2 x^2}{1 + \beta_3 x}, \ \ \beta_2 \neq 0, \ \beta_3 \neq 0$

**Function Family:** Rational

**Statistical Type:** Nonlinear

**Domain:** $\left(-\infty, \ -\dfrac{1}{\beta_3}\right) \ \cup \ \left(-\dfrac{1}{\beta_3}, \ \infty\right)$

**Range:**

$$\left\{ \begin{array}{lll} (-\infty, \, \infty) & \text{for} & \beta_2^2 - (\beta_1 - \beta_0\beta_3)\beta_2\beta_3 \leq 0 \\ & & \\ (-\infty, \, f_{max}] \, \cup \, [f_{min}, \, \infty) & \text{for} & \beta_2^2 - (\beta_1 - \beta_0\beta_3)\beta_2\beta_3 > 0 \end{array} \right.$$

with

$$f_{min} = \max\left[f\left(\frac{-\beta_2 - \sqrt{\beta_2^2 - \beta_0\beta_3}}{\beta_2\beta_3}\right), \ f\left(\frac{-\beta_2 + \sqrt{\beta_2^2 - \beta_0\beta_3}}{\beta_2\beta_3}\right)\right]$$

and

$$f_{max} = \min\left[f\left(\frac{-\beta_2 - \sqrt{\beta_2^2 - \beta_0\beta_3}}{\beta_2\beta_3}\right), \ f\left(\frac{-\beta_2 + \sqrt{\beta_2^2 - \beta_0\beta_3}}{\beta_2\beta_3}\right)\right]$$

**Special Features:** Vertical asymptote at $x = -\dfrac{1}{\beta_3}$.

##### Quadratic / Quadratic Rational Function {#sec-pmd-8125}

```{r}

#| fig-cap: "Examples of quadratic/quadratic rational functions"
p1 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(-20, 20)), aes(x)) +

  labs(title = "y = (1+2x+x^2)/(1-(1/12)x-(1/12)x^2)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

p2 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(-10, 10)), aes(x)) +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) (1 + 3 * x + x^2) / (1 + 2 * x + x^2)) +
  labs(title = "y = (1+3x+x^2)/(1+2x+x^2)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

p3 <- ggplot(tibble(x = c(-100, 100)), aes(x)) +
  stat_function(fun = \(x) (1 + 2 * x + x^2) / (1 + (1 / 15) * x + (1 / 15) * x^2)) +
  labs(title = "y = (1+2x+x^2)/(1+(1/15)x+(1/15)x^2)", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_light()

(p1 + p2) / p3
```

**Function:** $f(x) = \dfrac{\beta_0 + \beta_1 x + \beta_2 x^2}{1 + \beta_3 x + \beta_4 x^2}, \ \ \beta_2 \neq 0, \ \beta_4 \neq 0$

**Function Family:** Rational

**Statistical Type:** Nonlinear

**Domain:** $(-\infty, \infty)$ with undefined points at $x = \dfrac{-\beta_3 \pm \sqrt{\beta_3^2 - 4\beta_4}}{2\beta_4}$. There will be 0, 1, or 2 real solutions to this equation corresponding to whether $\beta_3^2 - 4\beta_4$ is negative, zero, or positive.

**Range:** The range is complicated and depends on the specific values of $\beta_1, \ldots, \beta_5$.

**Special Features:** Horizontal asymptotes at $y = \dfrac{\beta_2}{\beta_4}$ and vertical asymptotes at $x = \dfrac{-\beta_3 \pm \sqrt{\beta_3^2 - 4\beta_4}}{2\beta_4}$. There will be 0, 1, or 2 real solutions to this equation corresponding to whether $\beta_3^2 - 4\beta_4$ is negative, zero, or positive.
